rationale: The rooftop co-op leads on evidence and regulatory runway: a named community-energy route with a nearby co-op's reported savings (12000 across 30 homes) beats a subscription with no stated output and a bulk scheme with no shared asset. Its weakness is roof-repair interruption, answered by a maintenance reserve.
human_judge: panel-judge implementer reasoned expectation for the v1.0 gate (NOT an independent external human judge; see docs/EVAL-v1.0.md)
